Good to know

Common questions in Geelong

How much does a wedding photographer cost in Geelong?
What a wedding photographer costs in Geelong depends on coverage hours, the number of shooters, editing and inclusions like albums or prints. Requesting quotes from photographers who cover Geelong is the best way to see real local pricing for your day.
Do I need both a photographer and a videographer?
It comes down to how you want to remember the day. Photos give you timeless stills to print and hang, while video captures movement, sound and speeches. Many couples book both, and coordinated photo and video packages can make that simpler and more cost effective.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
How many hours of coverage do I need?
Most full weddings are covered across six to ten hours, from getting ready to the reception. Shorter events and corporate functions may only need two to four hours. Tell us your run sheet and we will help match coverage to it.
